name: browzer
description: AI agent skills to empower it with Browzer — hybrid vector + Graph RAG for codebases and document workspaces. Skills around the `browzer` CLI: RAG (embed-workspace-graphs, embed-documents, explore-workspace-graphs, semantic-search, dependency-graph, ingestion-jobs), workflow (brainstorming → generate-prd → generate-task → execute-task → code-review → receiving-code-review → write-tests → update-docs → feature-acceptance → commit → sync-workspace), orchestration (orchestrate-task-delivery with brainstorming-detection-first and a single execute-task invocation that internally resolves serial / parallel / parallel-worktrees / agent-teams strategy), ops (auth-status, workspace-management), and tools (use-rag-cli, browzer-bootstraper, find-skills). Code-review spawns 4 mandatory parallel agents — senior-engineer, software-architect, qa, regression-tester — the last running the canonical pre-push gate at PACKAGE granularity, enumerating failures per-test, and reproducing each against `main` via git stash for accurate `preExistingOnMain` flagging. Receiving-code-review closes EVERY finding with a 7-step ladder (sonnet → research → opus → research → log to tech-debt). Write-tests authors green coverage AND runs Stryker/mutmut/go-mutesting in the same pass. Feature-acceptance Phase 1.5 live-verifies; §2.5.1 metric anti-soft-override regex blocks autonomous `resolved:true` flips on dashboard/browser/`/ask`/`/sync` metrics without operator reply. Orchestrate-task-delivery drives the autonomous chain via an explicit loop in its skill body. Universal subagent preamble requires `browzer deps --reverse` blast-radius probing before any edit.
